title: Saudi Arabia and Houthis Exchange Strikes on Both Capitals' Airports
detail: Saudi Arabia and the Houthis exchanged strikes targeting both capitals' airports in a significant escalation. Houthi forces launched missile strikes on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport while the Saudi-led coalition conducted airstrikes on Sanaa International Airport. The simultaneous targeting of civilian aviation infrastructure in both capitals marks a dangerous new phase in the conflict.

title: Flights Between Kochi and Saudi Arabia Remain Disrupted Following Houthi Strikes
detail: Flights between Kochi, India and Saudi Arabian destinations remain disrupted following Houthi missile strikes on Riyadh's airport. The disruptions have significantly affected Indian expatriate travel between Kerala and Saudi Arabia, with airlines suspending or rerouting services. The flight cancellations illustrate the broader civilian impact of the escalating Houthi-Saudi exchange of strikes on aviation infrastructure.
